+import argparse
+import time
+
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.ep_moe.kernels import pre_reorder_triton_kernel
+
+
+def benchmark_pre_reorder_kernel(
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    topk: int,
+    num_experts: int,
+    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float16,
+    use_fp8: bool = False,
+    num_warmup: int = 10,
+    num_iters: int = 100,
+):
+    """Benchmark the pre_reorder_triton_kernel performance."""
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    
+    # Create input tensors
+    input_tensor = torch.randn(
+        num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device
+    )
+    
+    # Create topk_ids and src2dst mapping
+    topk_ids = torch.randint(
+        0, num_experts, (num_tokens, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    src2dst = torch.arange(
+        num_tokens * topk, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    ).reshape(num_tokens, topk)
+    
+    # Create output tensor
+    out_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn if use_fp8 else dtype
+    gateup_input = torch.empty(
+        num_tokens * topk, hidden_size, dtype=out_dtype, device=device
+    )
+    
+    # Create scales if using fp8
+    a1_scales = None
+    if use_fp8:
+        a1_scales = torch.randn(num_experts, dtype=torch.float32, device=device).abs()
+    
+    # Determine block size
+    BLOCK_SIZE = 128
+    
+    # Launch kernel
+    grid = (num_tokens,)
+    
+    # Warmup
+    for _ in range(num_warmup):
+        pre_reorder_triton_kernel[grid](
+            input_tensor,
+            gateup_input,
+            src2dst,
+            topk_ids,
+            a1_scales,
+            0,  # start_expert_id
+            num_experts - 1,  # end_expert_id
+            topk,
+            hidden_size,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+        )
+    
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    
+    # Benchmark
+    start_time = time.perf_counter()
+    for _ in range(num_iters):
+        pre_reorder_triton_kernel[grid](
+            input_tensor,
+            gateup_input,
+            src2dst,
+            topk_ids,
+            a1_scales,
+            0,  # start_expert_id
+            num_experts - 1,  # end_expert_id
+            topk,
+            hidden_size,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+        )
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    end_time = time.perf_counter()
+    
+    avg_time_ms = (end_time - start_time) / num_iters * 1000
+    
+    # Calculate throughput
+    total_bytes = num_tokens * hidden_size * input_tensor.element_size()
+    total_bytes += num_tokens * topk * hidden_size * gateup_input.element_size()
+    bandwidth_gb_s = (total_bytes / 1e9) / (avg_time_ms / 1000)
+    
+    return avg_time_ms, bandwidth_gb_s
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Benchmark pre_reorder_triton_kernel performance"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--num-tokens", type=int, default=4096, help="Number of tokens"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--hidden-size", type=int, default=4096, help="Hidden size"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--topk", type=int, default=2, help="Top-k experts per token"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--num-experts", type=int, default=8, help="Number of experts"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dtype",
+        type=str,
+        default="float16",
+        choices=["float16", "bfloat16"],
+        help="Data type",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--use-fp8", action="store_true", help="Use FP8 output"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--num-warmup", type=int, default=10, help="Number of warmup iterations"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--num-iters", type=int, default=100, help="Number of benchmark iterations"
+    )
+    
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    
+    dtype_map = {
+        "float16": torch.float16,
+        "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16,
+    }
+    dtype = dtype_map[args.dtype]
+    
+    print("=" * 80)
+    print("Benchmarking pre_reorder_triton_kernel")
+    print("=" * 80)
+    print(f"Configuration:")
+    print(f"  num_tokens: {args.num_tokens}")
+    print(f"  hidden_size: {args.hidden_size}")
+    print(f"  topk: {args.topk}")
+    print(f"  num_experts: {args.num_experts}")
+    print(f"  dtype: {args.dtype}")
+    print(f"  use_fp8: {args.use_fp8}")
+    print(f"  num_warmup: {args.num_warmup}")
+    print(f"  num_iters: {args.num_iters}")
+    print("=" * 80)
+    
+    avg_time_ms, bandwidth_gb_s = benchmark_pre_reorder_kernel(
+        num_tokens=args.num_tokens,
+        hidden_size=args.hidden_size,
+        topk=args.topk,
+        num_experts=args.num_experts,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        use_fp8=args.use_fp8,
+        num_warmup=args.num_warmup,
+        num_iters=args.num_iters,
+    )
+    
+    print(f"\nResults:")
+    print(f"  Average time: {avg_time_ms:.4f} ms")
+    print(f"  Bandwidth: {bandwidth_gb_s:.2f} GB/s")
+    print("=" * 80)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
